intent: PRIMARY function-health gate: no NEW function with cyclomatic complexity over 12 (1 + decision points + &&/||). Flags BRANCHY hard-to-test functions, not merely long ones (McCabe ~10; 12 is forgiving). Ratchet grandfathers today's complex functions and blocks any new one. (Scans git-non-ignored .ts; the robust-covariance numerics now live in the engine baseline kit, not Tessera.)
Coarse BACKSTOP: no NEW function over 150 lines (huge-but-flat functions only; complexity above is the primary gate). Ratchet.
No test pinned to a frozen git ref/SHA (git diff <ref>..HEAD, --name-only, git show <sha>). Such tests can only rot once HEAD moves past the change.

Product tests must not read local process state (coordination/ is a gitignored working dir). Tests depend only on tools/ + fixtures + coverage-matrices/. (Comment citations are fine — only code references count.)

No NEW untested source module under tools/. Ratchet grandfathers existing untested helpers and blocks any new module that ships without a base-name-matched *.test.ts (Anchor: require_tests is the deterministic half of test-discipline).
Durable project trail must exist (Anchor Discipline 6 deterministic backstop): a STATE.md snapshot and a decisions/ ADR directory. Existence only — accuracy/legibility is the human's call.

Meta-ratchet: invariants.json + baseline.json may only move forward vs HEAD — no raised max, dropped rule, severity downgrade, raised baseline, or grown exemption list without ARCH_ALLOW_RELAX=1 and review. The gate can't be quietly relaxed to pass.
